baselineCoverage.nonSvgColorCssShaderAndImageAssets: Reviewed for domain/category boundaries and semantic context, not treated as SVG glyphs. References are not local geometry representations. Material images are separate design-domain assets.

qualityPolicy.admission: One complete distinct construction, plan or interaction scene. Existing generic core concepts with decorative, count, pose, crop, numeric, direction, fill, material or style changes rejected. Exact/raster uniqueness alone is insufficient.
qualityPolicy.staticDomain: All 191 are design/shape/code/svg, not motion mechanisms, material textures or reference links. No MP4 required or added.
qualityPolicy.familyRepresentatives: No aliases are silently promoted; the report names the retained counterpart for new family exclusions. Rejected original source files remain available as evidence.

visualReview.limitation: Static source-authored silhouettes. No temporal comparison is claimed because these originals are not animated. Contact sheets establish actual constituent objects and spatial relationships, not a universal perceptual uniqueness proof.
